integrity: The fresh primary full text was inspected at the Fourier construction, first-mode expansion, inner and outer dilatation estimates, and diffeomorphism argument. The new asymptotic retains the first high-frequency leakage term instead of absorbing it into a little-o estimate, and compares it analytically with the source's quadratic first-mode gain. Numerical evaluation was used only as a sign sanity check.
scientific_limitations: The result quantifies only the sinusoidal high-frequency perturbation used in the cited harmonic-annulus counterexample. It does not claim minimal frequency among all possible perturbations, and the exact critical phase where the quadratic coefficient vanishes requires a higher-order analysis.
title: Sharp log–log frequency window for the harmonic annulus counterexample
